SELECT
    request_id,
    status,
    declared_priority,
    due_at,
    escalated_at
FROM service_requests
WHERE
    status IN ('Open', 'In Progress')
    AND due_at <= NOW()
    AND escalated_at IS NULL
ORDER BY due_at ASC;

WITH escalated_requests AS (
    UPDATE service_requests
    SET
        escalated_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE
        request_id = '{{ $json.request_id }}'
        AND escalated_at IS NULL
    RETURNING
        request_id,
        status,
        declared_priority,
        due_at,
        escalated_at
),
audit_event AS (
    INSERT INTO request_events (
        request_id,
        event_type,
        metadata
    )
    SELECT
        request_id,
        'SLA_BREACHED',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'priority', declared_priority,
            'due_at', due_at,
            'escalated_at', escalated_at
        )
    FROM escalated_requests
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    request_id,
    status,
    declared_priority,
    due_at,
    escalated_at
FROM escalated_requests;
